correctionPrompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only the optical lens guide in this pixel-art Dreamcast interior. The curved semicircular rails are mechanically wrong. Remove both curved rails and replace them with a short STRAIGHT pair of parallel metal guide rods running horizontally from the center spindle toward the right side of the circular well. assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separate empty Sega CD Model 1 disc tray sprite for the attached approved case. Image 1 is a style and perspective reference. Generate ONLY the empty black plastic sliding tray, isolated on transparent background. No console, no front logo flap, no controller, no cable, no disc, no text. The original Sega CD Model 1 has a thin rectangular tray with a large circular recess for a 12 cm CD and a concentric small center recess. View the tray from exactly the reference camera: front edge horizontal, depth recedes up-right, top and right side visible. Make it a rigid flat rectangular plane whose across vector is horizontal and whose rear-to-front depth vector goes down-left at about 1 horizontal unit to 2.5 vertical units. Draw the thin front rim and side rails, dark blue-black plastic, cool shadow and a few subtle gray highlights. Use the same crisp square pixel clusters and limited palette as the attached reference. The tray is approximately 500 pixels wide and 280 pixels deep in projection, centered with generous transparent margins on a 1254 square canvas. No photo texture, no glow, no ground shadow, no stretched oval tray. The CD recess should be a natural ellipse in this camera view.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separate NES Game Pak sprite for the attached approved console animation. Image 1 is a style and camera reference. Generate ONLY one original North American gray Nintendo Entertainment System cartridge, isolated on transparent background. Show it lying flat with label UP and connector edge at the FAR BACK, ready to slide away from the viewer into the front-loading console. The near gripping edge faces the viewer. Match the reference camera exactly: across edges horizontal and depth edges recede up-right. Use a rigid rectangular cartridge whose near-to-far projected depth vector is about 1 horizontal unit to 1.1 vertical units, up-right. No copyrighted game artwork, no invented text, no hands, no console, no controller, no cable, no shadow. Match the reference's crisp pixel clusters, limited gray palette, dark blue-gray outlines and warm upper-left highlight. The cartridge is wide and flat, not upright, not a Game Boy cartridge. Show its thin near edge. Center it with generous margins on a transparent 1254 square canvas.
